name: Constellation Beer DC - Wilmer TX (Dallas I-45)

fieldNotes._site: Facility identified as the Biagi Bros / Constellation Brands beer cross-dock at 1401 W Wintergreen Rd, Hutchins TX 75141 (roster listed it as Wilmer, but the actual operating address per Biagi Bros' own website is W Wintergreen Rd, Hutchins — same I-45/I-20 logistics corridor immediately adjacent to Wilmer). Confirmed via Biagi Bros website, Evans General Contractors project page, Good Beer Hunting 2016 Sightlines, and current (2026-02) Street View showing the operating building.
fieldNotes._geocode: Roster pin (32.589661, -96.678392) was Wilmer city geometric-center and ~5 km off the real building. Re-located via Nominatim + satellite to the verified Biagi building. Locked center 32.62120, -96.72950.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier-arm or sliding gate is clearly visible across the truck driveway in the available satellite imagery; the SW-end driveway off W Wintergreen Rd appears open. Set false but flagged uncertain — a 3PL beer DC of this class typically controls its entrance; a gate may exist but is not resolvable.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolvable at the entrance — false, uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True — this is a true cross-dock with dock doors on BOTH long faces: trailers backed in along the SE apron (truck distribution) and along the NW face (rail-side / receiving). The two dock banks are on physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Banded 50+. Roster cites 64 truck dock doors plus 24 rail doors. Overhead count of trailers backed in on both faces is consistent with a 50+ door building; exact count not verifiable from imagery — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 25-50 — a striped trailer-parking apron on the SE side holds dozens of drop trailers separate from active dock positions.
fieldNotes.railServed: Set true. A rail line runs immediately along the NW face of the building and the NW dock face is configured for rail-side handling; roster (Good Beer Hunting / Biagi / Evans GC) describes the build-to-suit as rail-served with 24 rail doors and capacity to unload four 30-car trains. A dedicated spur curving into the footprint is not crisply resolved in current imagery, so flagged uncertain — but the rail-adjacent NW dock configuration corroborates rail service.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The SE truck court is very wide / deep concrete apron — easily holds a 3+ truck queue between the entrance and the dock face.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron and large open truck court provide ample paved width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved truck court inside the property before the dock doors functions as a holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — the site sits on the developing edge of the Hutchins industrial corridor, surrounded by farm fields and open graded land; not embedded in dense metro fabric. Per rubric, edge-of-town industrial = Rural.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~41 acres operational footprint (building + truck court + trailer apron) estimated from the perimeter box; the broader parcel per RealtyTrac is ~33.7 acres for the building lot — perimeter box includes adjacent paved/graded yard.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large cross-dock building. Some adjacent construction activity is visible nearby but not part of this Constellation/Biagi parcel.
